name: glycol_runaround_recovery_loop
title: Air-to-air glycol run-around heat-recovery loop
summary: Run-around heat recovery between the extracted and the fresh air of an air handling unit: two epsilon-NTU coils under Braun's hypothesis (dry and wet regimes computed simultaneously, the regime of largest capacity kept), linked by a glycol loop with Colebrook piping pressure drop and a pump; glycol properties from the ULiège BrineProp library.
language_features: library procedure call (Brineprop, $INCLUDE brineprop_secondary_refrigerants with its lookup tables)

origin.course: ULiège model bank, air-to-air glycol recovery loop, 2008-01-10 (references Braun et al. 1989 and Ding et al. 1990)

verification.summary: Native file compared with the EES stored solution of GLYCOL_RECOVERY_LOOP_SB080110.EES: 143 common variables, 29 differ above rtol=0.001, max 5.31e-03 on W_cooling_c_wet, all humid-air quantities (EES vs CoolProp); glycol properties within 1.9e-05, pump power 1.7e-07, epsilon_recovery 3.0e-05. The runnable variant reaches a nonphysical root (CS-BUG-NEWTON-CYCLE).
verification.reference: EES stored solution in the source file (144 decoded variables, tools/ees_extract.py) against the native file with tools/compare_solution.py; earlier, pointwise only against the runnable variant (all equations satisfied at the stored point, largest residual 57 J/kg on h_cooling_c_wet, 0.22 %, humid-air formulation)
verification.notes: Native file blocked by CS-GAP-IF-DIRECTIVE (both $IF regime branches kept: 169 equations / 144 unknowns), CS-GAP-IF5, CS-GAP-CALL-EXPR-OUT and CS-GAP-INCLUDE (BrineProp USERLIB). The winter-resolved variant is square (271 equations, largest block 65) and stops on the solver bug CS-BUG-NEWTON-CYCLE; a T-RECHECK after that bug should solve it, verify against the stored solution and commit the .sol. 2026-11-04 (CoolSolve 0.4.0@2f4860b + loading of the tables of included models): the native file runs with $INCLUDE brineprop_secondary_refrigerants (BRINEPROP and its tables from CSL-0079) and the .initials of the EES stored solution (SingularJacobian on the 61-variable block from default guesses); compare_solution.py prints '143 common variables, 29 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 1; only in CoolSolve: 4' (epsilon is a stale EES variable); the 29 are humidity ratios, humid-air enthalpies, wet-coil fictitious-air properties, condensate and latent power (1.1e-03 to 5.31e-03). The variant now converges to a nonphysical root (t_gp_a_ex -11.9 C vs 3.9 C) and keeps no .sol.
